name: total-recall
description: Cross-session, cross-CLI memory for AI coding assistants. Mines transcripts from 8 supported CLI clients. Surfaces operator identity / decisions / bans / corrections / goals / voice via 26 MCP tools, 5 hooks (SessionStart signpost + UserPromptSubmit retrieval + Stop/PostCompact re-index + PreCompact seed), 15 slash commands, and 2 skills. Optional local-LLM refinement layer ([llm] extra, ollama, off by default). The operator becomes the source of truth; the model stops re-asking what they already told it.
